chapter: Sidemen, the Hampton years, race and money
title: Joe Gallo as manager and the Johnny Roberts date
summary: His accountants and attorney had ties to Gallo; Gallo's men scared off a hood who wanted him to record.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: You told me that Joey Gallo was your manager once. How did that happen?

Well, it was one of America's top wealthy families. She told me -- this girl in this family told me that Joey her was joint interest with our accountant. And he could help me in my profession. Joe Gallo also managed Stan Getz. It's the same people who managed Stan Getz. And that's who it was, Joe Gallo. I went to the crazy house and got out of the a new contract when I found out who he was. That's in the book, all that's in the book.

Yeah, there was a guy named Johnny Roberts, who was a light hood over from Brooklyn. And he wanted me to record for Brunswick Records. He used to get dates for me. I told him I didn't want to do it because I was -- I had my own company going, and so I told this accountant, Max Tanoff was the attorney and Al Kauf -- Al Tanoff and Max Kaufman. Kaufman was the attorney and Tanoff was the accountant, with Joe Gallo. And I told him, would they speak --

I didn't know Joe Gallo was who he was. I said, 'Will you speak to this guy Johnny Roberts, he wants me to do a date. And he keeps bugging me about it.' And I know he's a gangster, too. I was leery about telling him I didn't want to do it. But he told me not to do anything until our contract was straight with them.

So we have to talk to this guy. So they sent Joe Gallo to talk to him. It scared him to death. And this guy come and tell me, 'What did you do? All I did was offer you a record date?' Said, 'You sent the gorillas after me.' I said, 'I don't know, what do you mean, gorillas?' He said, 'I can't tell you, man, but they sent the gorillas after me, strong arm men. All I was doing was offering you a date.'

And so I went back downtown and they said, 'Well, I told you we'd get this guy off your back.' They said, 'We sent Joe Gallo to see him. That's who you're with. That's going to sound good on the tape recording. To splice that out. (Recording interrupted.) (End of Side Three.) T251 end
